segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say it absorbs without feeling heavy or tacky and several report breakouts slowing or stopping once they started using it, with no reports of it making their skin oilier.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe light hydration and calmer, less-stripped skin without burning, but a few call it too light to meaningfully fix dryness, saying it only "takes the edge off" or may not be enough on its own for very dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it balancing oil while still hydrating drier patches and calming breakouts and redness without irritation, though one found it not hydrating enough used alone.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report calm, non-irritating results, including on rosacea and open breakouts, though one reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin says it did nothing for her and suspected it was made more for mature skin.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying normal, slightly dry-leaning skin found it soothing and lightly hydrating without feeling heavy.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers who also describe firmness or texture improvements say their skin looked more elastic, firmer and brighter after a few weeks of regular use, though most reviews don't address visible aging signs directly.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness or dehydration say it delivers light hydration and calms dry or dehydrated patches, and several credit it with keeping their dryness under control day-to-day. A recurring minority instead find it too light to meaningfully hydrate: a few say it did nothing for their dryness or even left skin drier, and some note they still need to apply a moisturizer right after.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including several managing rosacea, report visibly reduced redness and calmer skin, often within days of starting. One reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin is a clear dissent, saying it did nothing for her redness at all.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe it helping restore or protect the skin barrier, used to calm skin after harsh treatments or exfoliation and to keep it from getting drier in colder months, and one reviewer with doctor-diagnosed eczema reports no flare-ups since starting it.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report their skin tone looking more even and hyperpigmentation settling with continued use; no reviewer reports dark spots or tone getting worse.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention blemishes report calmer breakouts, with existing spots fading faster, painful or hormonal pimples clearing, and several saying it prevented new breakouts even on acne-prone or oily skin. Against this, a distinct minority of mostly one-star reviews say the toner itself triggered new breakouts, describing tiny pimples across the forehead and cheeks or bumps appearing within about a week of starting it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe it as hydrating without adding grease or heaviness, and a couple specifically credit it with balancing oil production in typically oily zones like the forehead and jaw; none report it increasing oiliness.

extraits.titre: Gentle, But Lacked Impact on My Skin"
extraits.texte: I had high hopes when I tried the Heartleaf 77 Soothing Toner, especially given its claims to soothe and hydrate sensitive, dry skin. With 77% Heartleaf extract as the main ingredient, it's designed to calm the skin, which sounded like exactly what my skin needed. The texture of the toner is light and refreshing, and it absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky residue, which I appreciated. However, after using it for a few weeks, I didn't notice any dramatic changes in my skin's overall appearance, texture, or hydration levels. It didn't irritate my skin, which is a definite plus for anyone with sensitive skin like mine. But unfortunately, it didn't deliver on its promise to add extra hydration or provide significant relief from dryness. It felt more like a basic toner rather than something that deeply nourishes or soothes, which is what I was hoping for. While I didn't see noticeable improvements, I can see how this product could be a good option for people who want a gentle toner that won't disrupt the skin's natural balance. It's a great option if you're looking for something mild, but for those with more demanding skin concerns, it may not offer the extra boost you need.

This toner has been a game changer for my combination skin! I used to be terrible with my skin care routine and never implemented a toner. I just started using it but I can already see a difference in my skins hydration. It has helped calm some stubborn breakouts on my chin and jaw that nothing else seemed to fix. I even had a couple of painful and inflamed pimples starting on my forehead and this toner worked its magic. They're almost completely gone now! I decided to give this a try and added the toner to my skin routine and I'm glad I did. It's super soothing and feels light yet hydrating on my skin. My only tiny complaint is that the consistency is very watery but it's still worth every drop. I'm pretty sure this will become a staple in my routine!

I have super oily and acne prone skin. But i wear makeup on a daily basis. This product tones your skin gently and cleans out any leftover makeup perfectly in one go without the need to go in more than once. It hydrates my skin without drying it down. My skin always feels hydrated, and bouncy after using this toner. The toner has never led me to a breakout. In fact i believe it has prevented breakouts for me since i started using it. You can use the product by with either a cotton pad and rubbing it on your skin with the cotton pad, or by just taking some in your hand and pushing it into your skin. I do this step after using an oil cleansing solution to remove my makeup and then using a face wash to clean the oil and any remaining makeup. Rub this on your face for 20-30 seconds to ensure all parts of your face are covered, and feel clean and hydrated. After this step you can proceed with a serum or moisture of your choice. This is super gentle on the skin and even on days that I have a breakout on the face this product is not too harsh. 10/10 would recommend.

Heartleaf 77+ Soothing Toner: A Daily Essential The Heartleaf 77+ Soothing Toner has become a staple in my routine for its gentle, calming properties. I use it every day, and it's perfect for balancing my skin after cleansing. Infused with 77% heartleaf extract, this toner is incredibly soothing, making it ideal for sensitive or irritated skin. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it hydrated and refreshed without any sticky residue. I've noticed that it helps calm redness and keeps my skin's moisture barrier intact, even during colder months when my skin tends to get drier in certain areas. What sets this toner apart is its simplicity and effectiveness. It doesn't try to do too much—it just delivers what your skin needs: hydration, soothing, and balance. Whether you're a skincare minimalist or looking for a gentle toner to layer into your multi-step routine, the Heartleaf 77+ Soothing Toner is a must-have.
